title: Samsung J3 Unboxing | MetroPCS | Product Review
description:
Watch the unboxing of the Samsung Galaxy J3 Prime MetroPCS phone. It does everything you love, with a large HD screen, ample internal storage and rear camera optimized for low light photography.

The Samsung Galaxy J3 Prime is a solid LTE smartphone with:

• Beautiful 5.0-inch HD display allows you to enjoy social media and video streaming with bright, full pictures
• The Samsung Galaxy J3 Prime has autofocus rear camera with large aperture optimized for low light. This is a fast lens aperture that helps you to get well-exposed images when shooting in low light situations
• Large 2600 mAh battery with ultra power savings mode providing extended battery life when needed
